title: Chat App realtime events
description: Socket.IO namespace /rt. Connect with auth: { token: <accessToken> }. Server joins the socket to rooms user:{userId} and device:{deviceId}. Canonical copy lives in the api repo at contracts/ws-events.schema.json.

device:revoked.description: Sent to device:{deviceId}. Client must wipe local data and return to sign-in.

profile:updated.description: Sent to user:{id} of the user and of every user who has them as a contact.

auth:expired.description: Sent just before the server disconnects a socket whose access token expired. Client refreshes and reconnects.

client-to-server.description: No client-to-server events in feature 001. Connection errors use Socket.IO connect_error with data.code in [UNAUTHORIZED, SESSION_REVOKED].
